postings.text: Consultant - East Africa Content and Digital Officer | IRC - International Rescue Committee Skip to main content Consultant - East Africa Content and Digital Officer IRC - International Rescue Committee Nairobi International Mid level Speaks English Apply Summary by Impactpool The International Rescue Committee (IRC) is seeking a Consultant - East Africa Content and Digital Officer to join their Communications, Mobilization & Marketing team. This role focuses on gathering and producing multimedia content that highlights the humanitarian efforts in East Africa. The consultant will work closely with programming and communications colleagues to develop strategic messaging and storytelling that brings attention to the region's crises and resilience. The ideal candidate will have experience in multimedia production, social media management, and a strong understanding of humanitarian issues. Candidate Requirements: 3-5 years of multimedia content production experience Experience living and working in East Africa Social media management and analytics skills Proven track record in multimedia package development Fluency in post-production processes Proficiency with multimedia production tools Strong written and verbal communication skills Ability to work independently and collaboratively Willingness to travel and work unusual hours Ability to think creatively in fast-paced environments The International Rescue Committee (IRC) responds to the world's worst humanitarian crises, helping to restore health, safety, education, economic wellbeing, and power to people devastated by conflict and disaster. Founded in 1933 at the call of Albert Einstein, the IRC is one of the world's largest international humanitarian non-governmental organizations (INGO), at work in more than 40 countries and 29 U.S. cities helping people to survive, reclaim control of their future and strengthen their communities. A force for humanity, IRC employees deliver lasting impact by restoring safety, dignity and hope to millions. If you're a solutions-driven, passionate change-maker, come join us in positively impacting the lives of millions of people world-wide for a better future. Title: Consultant - East Africa Content and Digital Officer Total number of Consultants: 1 Country Program: Global Communications/Public Affairs Proposed Dates: 2 November 2026- 30 September 2027 Duration: TBC Background of the project Important note: Always define and spell out all acronyms or technical terms Scope of work ● Part of the IRC's Communications, Mobilization & Marketing team, the Content and Digital consultant for East Africa will focus on identifying, gathering and packaging powerful content (photo, video, audio, etcetera) from the region to connect audiences to IRC's work and support our goals of building income, profile and influence. ● We are looking for a team member with experience operating in fluid and complex environments, who has a deep understanding of the humanitarian and social issues facing communities in the East Africa region (and preferably overall the humanitarian sector). This person should be a dedicated storyteller with a gift for identifying compelling subjects and angles, and creative ways of telling stories in difficult circumstances. They will develop information and content assets that showcase our on the ground impact. ● A strong multimedia producer with solid writing, graphic and digital engagement skills, this position will work closely with frontline colleagues to gather critical programming information, spot stories, train programming colleagues, and collect content. They will also help support regional communications and advocacy objectives. Deliverables: The consultant will work in close collaboration with programming and communications colleagues to deliver high-quality digital assets, strategic messaging, and storytelling that bring the realities of East Africa’s crises and the resilience of its people to global attention. The project will include: 1. Strategy Development and Execution o Support in the execution of the East Africa content strategy in consultation with IRC’s Associate Director, Public Affairs for Africa and Emergencies, IRC’s Senior Producer for Content and Strategy, Africa, East Africa regional colleagues and country-level colleagues. o Support in developing an editorial calendar/strategy for increased engagement and content on the East Africa Instagram page, 2. Content Gathering and end-to-end Production o Work with the creative studio team and in-country communications colleagues to identify stories and conduct field visits to gather digital content (photo, video, written stories) from frontline programs to form a bank of stories to be used externally. o Develop compelling human-interest stories and case studies for external audiences and donors. o Ensure content reflects diverse voices, with particular attention to children, women, and marginalized groups. o Produce multimedia assets optimized for global social media and digital platforms. o Process and organise raw assets for the IRC’s digital archive (i.e. Brandfolder, Lucidlink, or Ikonik) o Train vendors on the IRC's brand guidelines and processing requirements. Work closely with the creative studio to support vendor selection to ensure they meet brand requirements. 3. Supporting Donor Visibility Needs o Work together with Donor Visibility Officers to ensure requirements for East Africa grants are met o If needed, help coordinate logistics and story identification between country teams and HQ donor visibility officers o Review materials for publication drafted for the East Africa region for messaging and redlines 4. Capacity Strengthening o Train an agreed upon number of program colleagues in story-spotting, content gathering, and messaging. o Create user-friendly guidance and templates for staff contributing to communications efforts. 5. Manage the East Africa Instagram Channel o Develop an editorial calendar for the East Africa Instagram Channel o Produce and share content on the channel that engages stakeholders and promotes IRC’s work in the region o Join a Digital Engagement community of practice to ensure up-to-date practices and knowledge sharing. Requirements: ● Minimum 3-5 years of professional experience producing multimedia digital content for an international news outlet, company or nonprofit organization. Strong interest in international affairs and humanitarian issues. ● Experience living in and working in East Africa ● Experience running and growing social media communities and excellent command of social media management tools and analytics. ● Proven track record in developing compelling multi-media packages (with some combination of photo, video, and graphic skills. ● Have fluency in all elements of post-production including backing up data; building and organizing Adobe Premiere project files; color correction and grading; sound design; motion graphics; editing music tracks; building engaging and coherent sequences; exporting; compression; sharing out results in different formats; and preservation of completed projects for archiving. ● Demonstrable proficiency with multimedia and film production tools. ● Sharp written and verbal communication skills. ● Ability to work well independently and as part of a team; comfortable collaborating with and channeling the multiple collaborators involved in NGO communications projects. ● Eager to travel widely and willing to work unusual hours. ● Able to think and take action quickly and creatively in fast-paced environments. Professional Standards: All International Rescue Committee workers must adhere to the core values and principles outlined in IRC Way - Standards for Professional Conduct . Our Standards are Integrity, Service, Equality and Accountability. In accordance with these values, the IRC operates and enforces policies on Safeguarding , Conflicts of Interest, Fiscal Integrity, and Reporting Wrongdoing and Protection from Retaliation. IRC is committed to take all necessary preventive measures and create an environment where people feel safe, and to take all necessary actions and corrective measures when harm occurs. IRC builds teams of professionals who promote critical reflection, power sharing, debate, and objectivity to deliver the best possible services to our clients. postings.text: REPÚBLICA DE MOÇAMBIQUE MINISTÉRIO DA EDUCAÇÃO E CULTURA  DEPARTAMENTO DE AQUISIÇÕES   PROJECTO INTEGRA Acordo de Financiamento- P509826   Referência n.º 26/CS/IC/INTEGRA/2026 _________________________________________________ ANÚNCIO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE Contratação de Consultor Individual para a Posição de Especialista em Salvaguardas Ambientais O Ministério da Educação e Cultura (MEC), no quadro da implementação do Programa Quinquenal do Governo de Moçambique, dispõe de um Plano Estratégico do Sector da Educação, cuja execução é financiada por recursos do Orçamento do Estado e por Parceiros de Cooperação (PC), através de mecanismos como a Parceria Global para Educação e Banco Mundial, onde está a implementar do Projecto Integrado de Desenvolvimento Humano (INTEGRA). O Projecto INTEGRA visa reforçar a prestação de serviços de desenvolvimento humano, com intervenções integradas nos sectores da educação, saúde e protecção social, abrangendo distritos seleccionados das províncias de Cabo Delgado, Gaza, Nampula, Tete e Zambézia. Neste contexto, o MEC pretende contratar um/a Especialista em Salvaguardas Ambientais cujo objectivos desta consultoria são entre outros os seguintes: a) Assegurar a gestão ambiental, de saúde e segurança ocupacional no âmbito da implementação do Projecto INTEGRA; b) Identificar, avaliar, prevenir e mitigar os riscos e impactos ambientais associados à construção e reabilitação de infraestruturas escolares; c) Garantir a elaboração, implementação e monitoria dos instrumentos de gestão ambiental e social, em conformidade com as normas do Banco Mundial e a legislação nacional; d) Monitorar o cumprimento das medidas ambientais e de saúde e segurança ocupacional durante a execução das obras, propondo medidas correctivas sempre que necessário; e) Promover a capacitação das equipas do MEC, empreiteiros e fiscais, bem como apoiar as consultas comunitárias e o tratamento de reclamações; f) Realizar visitas de campo, acompanhar incidentes e não conformidades, elaborar relatórios periódicos e participar nas missões de supervisão do Banco Mundial. Assim, o MEC convida consultores individuais elegíveis e devidamente qualificados a apresentarem as suas manifestações de interesse para a contratação de um/a Especialista em Salvaguardas Ambientais , que prestará apoio técnico na identificação, avaliação, prevenção, mitigação, monitoria e reporte dos riscos e impactos ambientais associados às actividades do Projecto.   5. Os candidatos deverão reunir os seguintes requisitos: Formação académica: Ensino superior em Geografia, Engenharia Ambiental, Ciências do Ambiente ou áreas afins; Experiência profissional: Mais de 8 anos de experiência comprovada na área ambiental, sendo a experiência mínima de 4 anos na área de infraestruturas constitui uma vantagem; Gestão ambiental: Experiência na implementação de planos de mitigação ambiental e social e na avaliação de impactos ambientais e sociais; Saúde e segurança: Conhecimentos sólidos em saúde e segurança ocupacional e segurança das comunidades envolventes; Capacitação: Capacidade de ministrar formação em serviço às equipas envolvidas na implementação do Projecto; Idiomas: Fluência em Português e conhecimentos de Inglês, falado e escrito; Quadro legal: Familiaridade com as políticas, leis e regulamentos ambientais e de terras de Moçambique, bem como com o Quadro Ambiental e Social do Banco Mundial; Registo profissional: Possuir cadastro ou registo junto do sector que superintende a área do ambiente em Moçambique;   6. O contrato terá a duração de 24 meses , com possibilidade de renovação, mediante avaliação semestral positiva do desempenho. 7. Os consultores individuais interessados deverão apresentar os seguintes documentos: Carta de manifestação de interesse ou de motivação; Curriculum Vitae detalhado, actualizado e assinado; Cópias dos certificados das qualificações académicas relevantes autenticados; Pelo menos três referências profissionais contactáveis, com indicação dos nomes, endereços electrónicos e números de telefone. 8. A selecção será efectuada pelo método de Selecção de Consultores Individuais , nos termos do Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial para Mutuários de Operações de Financiamento de Projectos de Investimento (IPF) Edição de Setembro de 2025. Serão observados os requisitos de elegibilidade e as disposições relativas a conflitos de interesses. 9. Informações adicionais e Termos de Referência podem ser obtidos no endereço abaixo indicado (parágrafo 11), dias úteis, das 8h00 às 15h00 ou pelo endereço de electronico mencionado no mesmo parágrafo. 10. As Manifestações de Interesse deverão ser entregues no endereço abaixo até as 15h do dia 14 Dezembro de 2026 . Os envelopes contendo a manifestação de interesse deverão estar claramente identificados da seguinte forma: Ref.: EOI - 26/CS/IC/INTEGRA/2026- Especialista em Salvaguardas Ambientais . Apenas serão contactados os consultores pr é - selecionados.   11. Endereço Ministério da Educação e Cultura Departamento de Aquisições Avenida 24 de Julho n.º 167, 7º Andar, porta 703 - Maputo - Moçambique Email: aquisicoes.mindeh@gmail.com   Maputo,  13 de Novembro de 2026 A Secretária Permanente Ilegível

postings.text: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST   SAINT LUCIA UNLEASHING THE BLUE ECONOMY OF THE CARIBBEAN (UBEC) Project ID: P171833 – IDA Credit No. 70880   Assignment Title: FINANCE OFFICER   Reference No . LC-MOFED-571341-CS-INDV-FO-26-2   Saint Lucia has received financing from the World Bank toward the cost of the Unleashing the Blue Economy of the Caribbean (UBEC) project and intends to apply part of the proceeds to hire an Individual Consultant as Finance Officer UBEC.   The consulting services (“the Services”) include the following objective:   The Finance Officer (FO) will be responsible for the financial management functions in the Project Implementation Unit (PIU), overseeing the day-to-day financial management for all accounting, financial planning and budgeting, reporting, disbursements, internal controls, financial management system and supervision of a Finance Assistant hired to support the Project. The FO is the responsible officer and functional owner of the annual audits, budgeting (annual and supplementary), periodic financial and capital expenditure reporting including World Bank Interim Financial Reports (IFRs) and ad hoc reports of a primarily financial nature as well as the procedures, processes, techniques and tools necessary to execute these functions. Accordingly, the FO is accountable for coordination, execution, collation and submission of all documentation in satisfaction of requests and requirements from recipients of the foregoing outputs and associated inputs, whether they are produced by the Finance Unit or not.  The FO functions will be undertaken in accordance with the related provisions of the Project Operation Manual.   The Finance Officer is a full-time position, renewable annually based on performance and availability of funds.   The detailed Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website: www.finance.gov.lc   The Department of Finance now invites eligible Individual Consultants (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services. (Curriculum Vitae with supporting certified copies of certificates, reference letters to support experience and description of similar assignments, etc.)   Interested Consultants should have the following requisite minimum qualifications and professional experiences listed below for undertaking the assignment.       Qualification s Master’s Degree in accountancy, finance, or similar qualification plus at least two (2) years’ experience as a project finance specialist in a donor funded project, or in financial and budget management in a similar role. OR Bachelor’s Degree in accountancy, finance, or similar qualification plus at least five (5) years’ experience as a project finance specialist in a donor funded project, or in financial and budget management in a similar role.   Relevant post graduate accounting or professional accounting qualification (e.g. ACCA, CPA) is preferred.   High proficiency in Microsoft Office suite applications, QuickBooks and Government of Saint Lucia accounting software, excellent web navigation skills   Demonstrated experience in maintaining strong internal controls, preparing financial procedures, supporting audit processes, and ensuring compliance with financial management requirements in a timely and efficient manner.   Desirable Capacity to work simultaneously on a variety of issues and tasks, independently adjusting to priorities and achieving results with agreed objectives and deadlines. Strong integrity, ethics, personal organizational skills, and ability to manage own workload. Good communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to make presentations and to explain the main principles of financial management to a broad range of audiences Ability to demonstrate autonomy in solving problems/challenges that may arise during Project life span Good writing skills with the ability to prepare accurate reports; fluency (oral and written) in English is essential. Ability to prepare detailed and accurate financial reports in a timely manner. Sound knowledge of the financial Administration and Audit (FAA) Act, Public Bodies Management and Accountability Act, International Public Sector Accounting Standards (IPSAS) and/or International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) and International Standards on Auditing. Familiarity with the Public Procurement Act  Experience with reporting requirements, systems, procedures and methods of donor-funded projects, especially projects involving international financial institutions such as the World Bank. Membership within a relevant professional organization.   The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to paragraph 3.14, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations: World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers Fourth Edition, November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.     A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultants (IC) method set out in the World Bank’s   Procurement Regulations: World Bank Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers Fourth Edition, November 2020 (“Procurement Regulations”).      Further information can be obtained at the address below during office hours 8:00 a.m. - 4:30 p.m. (0800 to 1600 hours). Expressions of interest must be submitted via the Saint Lucia Electronic Government Procurement portal (eGP): https://in-tendhost.co.uk/goslprocurement/aspx/Home ) by 9:30 a.m. December 10, 2026.   Attention: Chairperson, Public Procurement Committee , Department of Finance, Constituency Development and People Empowerment, Address: 4th Floor Finance Administration Centre, Pointe Seraphine City: Castries Country: Saint Lucia     Cc:   Calus Monchery Procurement Manager UBEC Saint Lucia Ministry of Finance, Economic Development & the Youth Economy Financial Administrative Centre Pointe Seraphine, Castries, Saint Lucia Email: calus.monchery@govt.lc , procurement.ubec@gmail.com Cell: 1-758-728-9642   Shermaine Clauzel Project Manager UBEC Saint Lucia Ministry of Finance, Economic Development & the Youth Economy Financial Administrative Centre Pointe Seraphine, Castries, Saint Lucia Email: project.manager.ubec@gmail.com

postings.text: REPÚBLICA DE MOÇAMBIQUE MINISTÉRIO DOS TRANSPORTES E LOGISTICA Projecto de Comércio e Conectividade de África Austral PEDIDO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE CONTRATAÇÃO DE SERVIÇOS DE CONSULTORIA PARA ELABORAÇÃO DO PROJECTO EXECUTIVO DO EDIFÍCIO SEDE DO INSTITUTO FERRO - PORTUÁRIO DE MOÇAMBIQUE (IFEPOM)   Projecto nº P164847 Número de Referência: 125/SATCP/CS-QCBS/2022   1. O Governo de Moçambique, através do Ministério dos Transportes e Logística (MTL), está a implementar o Projecto de Comércio e Conectividade da África Austral (PCCAA), com financiamento do Banco Mundial. O projeto visa reduzir os custos e o tempo do comércio, aumentar a coordenação regional do comércio, desenvolver cadeias de valor regionais e melhorar o acesso à infraestrutura. Isso inclui investimentos ao longo dos Corredores de Nacala e Beira que ligam Moçambique ao Malawi, e ao longo do Corredor de Maputo que liga Moçambique à África do Sul através da Ponta do Ouro.   2. O PCCAA prevê intervenções em 04 (quatro) componentes, sendo: 1. Redução dos custos comerciais, através da facilitação do comércio; 2. Reforço da coordenação regional e implementação de projetos; 3. Desenvolvimento de cadeias de valor; e 4. Reforço de infraestruturas de transporte para melhoria do acesso ao mercado.   3. Assim, o MTC pretende aplicar parte dos fundos do PCCAA para Contratação de Serviços de Consultoria para a Elaboração do Projecto Executivo do Edifício Sede do Instituto Ferro - Portuário de Moçambique (IFEPOM).   4. O objetivo desta consultoria é concepção e desenvolvimento de projecto executivo completo referente à construção de um edifício de múltiplos andares e moderno, destinado a escritórios e/ou uso misto, numa área urbana de aproximadamente 850 m2.   5. Para prossecucao, o MTL, através do Projeto de Comércio e Conectividade da África Austral, convida empresas de consultoria interessadas e elegíveis a manifestarem interesse em realizar a consultoria. As empresas de consultoria interessadas devem fornecer informações relevantes para demonstrar sua elegibilidade em termos de qualificação exigida, experiência, competência técnica e profissional para a implementação bem-sucedida da tarefa (via folhetos, descrição de trabalhos semelhantes realizados, anos de experiência na área, incluindo experiência em trabalho de natureza similar, etc)   6. A empresa de consultoria será selecionada de acordo com os procedimentos do Banco Mundial definidos no Regulamento de Aquisição de Operações de Financiamento de Projetos de Investimento, edição de Setembro de 2023. O método de seleção será baseado na Qualidade e Custo (QCBS) e o contrato deverá durar quatro (4) meses.   7. Os critérios de lista curta serão os seguintes: (i) A empresa de consultoria deve estar no mercado há pelo menos 10 anos; (ii) Pelo menos 7 anos de experiência na elaboração de projectos executivos. (iii) Pelo menos 5 anos de experiencia na elaboração de cadernos de encargos para processos de licitação da empreitada (iv) Pelo menos 3 projectos elaborados de natureza similar nos últimos 5 anos e a manifestação de interesse deve ter no máximo 25 páginas.   8. Os consultores interessados podem consultar ou solicitar os Termos de Referência no endereço abaixo, nas horas normais de expediente.   9. Os envelopes contendo as Manifestações de Interesse deverão ser enviados com as seguintes indicações: Ref.: 125/SATCP/CS-QCBS/2022 - Contratação de Serviços de Consultoria para a Elaboração do Projecto Executivo do Edifício Sede do Instituto Ferro - Portuário de Moçambique (IFEPOM)   10. As Manifestações de Interesse podem ser enviadas eletronicamente (preferencialmente) ou fisicamente em português ou inglês até o dia 1 de Dezembro de 2026 , às 14h (horário local) para o endereço abaixo.   Endereço:   Ministério dos Transportes e Logistica Projecto de Comércio e Conectividade da África Austral Av. postings.text: Country:          Federal Government of Somalia (FGS) Name of the Project: Somalia Productive, Resilient, and Inclusive Growth (SPRING)   Assignment Title: Cybersecurity Expert for National Payment System (NPS) Project ID:     P501662 Individual/Firm:   Individual Selection Deadline for submission of EOI: November 30,2026 at 4:00pm Ref No.    SO-MOF-576060-CS-INDV   1. Background: In May 2025, the Federal Republic of Somalia, through its Ministry of Finance (MoF) launched the Somalia Productive, Resilient, and Inclusive Growth (SPRING) project. The project development objective is to promote private sector-led growth and job creation by improving the business-enabling environment, strengthening the financial system, and enhancing access to finance. The SPRING project is organized around four components (three mutually reinforcing and one supporting): (i) Component 1: Improving the enabling environment for the private sector; (ii) Component 2: Deepening financial sector reforms and strengthening institutional capacity; (iii) Component 3: Enhancing access to finance and resilience for MSMEs; and (iv) Component 4: Project Management. A wide range of activities will be implemented as part of this project to reach its development objective, such as improvements to regulatory/institutional frameworks, the rollout of the digital ID system, financial sector reforms, the creation of a risk-sharing mechanism, and the provision of business development services for micro, small and medium enterprises in select economic sectors, among others. The MoF received US$105 million from the World Bank, including US$10 million from the Somalia Multi-Partner Fund to implement the SPRING project. As part of this initiative, deepening financial sector reforms and strengthening institutional capacity, MoF intends to apply part of the proceeds from the World Bank to finance the position of Cybersecurity Expert for National Payment System (NPS). 2. Responsibilities:   The Cyber Security Expert will provide Cybersecurity Strategy, Governance & Function Establishment; Cyber Risk Management, Compliance & Assurance; Security Architecture, Engineering & Secure Development; Security Operations, Monitoring & Incident Response; Identity, Privileged; Vulnerability Management, Security Testing & Threat Management; Cyber Resilience, Business Continuity & Disaster Recovery; Participant, Third-Party & Supply-Chain Security; Security Awareness, Team Capability & Knowledge Transfer; All other specific tasks detailed in the Terms of Reference (TOR) for the assignment can be found at the following website link:  https://sps.so/docs/TOR%20for%20Cybersecurity%20Expert%20Terms%20at%20NPS.pdf 3.Skills and qualifications   Selection Criteria: The selection shall be based on the qualifications, experience and skills of the candidate and followed by an interview. The qualifications, experience and competencies include: Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Technology, Network Security, Computer Engineering, or a closely related discipline is required. A Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Networks and Security, Information Systems, Technology Risk, or a related discipline is strongly preferred. Minimum 10 years of progressive professional experience in cybersecurity, information security, technology risk, IT governance, or security assurance, with substantial hands-on responsibility in regulated or high-availability environments. At least 5 years of experience in a senior, lead, managerial, or consulting role responsible for information-security governance, cyber-risk management, security operations, or cybersecurity transformation. Demonstrated experience establishing, materially uplifting, or leading an information-security or cybersecurity function, ISMS, SOC/security-monitoring capability, incident-response programme, or comparable enterprise security capability. At least two recognized professional cybersecurity or information-security credential is required, such as CISSP, CISM, CRISC, GIAC, ISO/IEC 27001 Lead Implementer/Lead Auditor or Senior Lead Implementer, or an equivalent recognized certification. 4. Duration:  The proposed duration for the assignment is Twelve Months (12) calendar months from starts date. 5 . The Ministry of Ministry of Finance now invites eligible consulting (“Consultants”) to indicate their interest in providing the above-mentioned Services. Interested Consultants should provide information demonstrating that they have the required qualifications and relevant experience to perform the Services and furnish the Curriculum Vitae (CV). 6. Attention of interested Consultants is drawn to section III, para 3.14, 3.16 & 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: Procurement in Investment Projects Financing Goods, Works, Non -Consulting and Consulting Services dated in September 2023 (Procurement Regulations), setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest.     7. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Individual Consultant method set out in the World Bank Procurement Regulations . 8 . Interested Consultant may obtain further information (in person or by e-mail) at the address below during office hours from 8.00 a.m. – 4.00 p.m. Saturday to Thursday except on public holidays. 9. Deadline for submission: Expressions of interest should be delivered in a written form to the address below (in person, or by e-mail) by November 30, 2026, at 4:00pm (Somalia Local time) Attention; Project Coordinator SPRING Project Ministry of Finance Federal Government of Somalia Shangani District, Mogadishu, Somalia Email Address:  bid.spring@piu.mof.gov.so Copy to: hr@sps.so

postings.text: REPÚBLICA DE MOÇAMBIQUE   MINISTÉRIO DAS FINANÇAS Direcção Nacional do Tesouro e Cooperação Financeira   MOÇAMBIQUE: PROJECTO DE ACESSO AO FINANCIAMENTO E OPORTUNIDADES ECONÓMICAS: MAIS OPORTUNIDADES Unidade de Coordenação do Projecto SOLICITAÇÃO DE MANIFESTAÇÃO DE INTERESSE (Serviços de Consultoria Individual) ESPECIALISTA DE CONTABILIDADE    Identificação: Projecto N.o P17865. Crédito IDA no 7278 Objecto: Especialista de Contabilidade Referência: Concurso N.o MZ-MEF-DNT-577532-CS-INDV.   1. O Governo de Moçambique (GdM), através do Ministério das Finanças recebeu um financiamento do Banco Mundial para o custo do Projecto de Acesso ao Financiamento e Oportunidades Económicas: Mais Oportunidades e pretende aplicar parte dos recursos em Serviços de Consultoria Individual para Especialista de Contabilidade.   2. Os serviços de Consultoria (“Serviços”) incluem a realização das seguintes tarefas em colaboração com a com a Gestora Financeira do Projecto, observando sempre as regras, os procedimentos e requisitos do Governo de Moçambique, do Banco Mundial, conforme exigir o processo: Organizar o Sistema contabilístico de acordo com os procedimentos do e-SISTAFE e outros sistemas informáticos do Projecto, incluindo a conformidade com os procedimentos do Banco Mundial;  Preparar, em coordenação com a equipa do Projecto, os Planos e Orçamento e fazer o controlo mensal da execução dos planos de actividades;  Preparar toda documentação necessária para o processo de desembolsos e realimentação  da conta designada e monitorar as realimentações com base no orçamento aprovado; Assegurar o pagamento atempado das despesas, em conformidade com as regras do SISTAFE e Banco Mundial; Garantir que todos os documentos de contabilidade estejam em ordem e sejam introduzidos correctamente nos sistemas de contabilidade em uso no Projecto (e-SISTAFE e noutros softwares de contabilidade que possam ser estabelecidos);         Contabilizar nos sistemas em uso no projecto todas as operações (Contabilidade, Monitoria e Avaliação, gestão de contractos, gestão da planificação e outros existentes) todas as transacções contabilísticas, em tempo, reconciliar e produzir relatórios periódicos para a Gestão do Projecto; Preparar os relatórios que dizem respeito a componente financeira e contabilística numa base mensal, trimestral, semestral e anual a ser agregado no '’Financial Monitoring Report”, em paralelo com os planos periódicos; Apoiar o/a Gestor/a Financeiro/a na preparação das informações financeiras periódicas para o Banco Mundial, Ministério das Finanças e Instituições Beneficiárias; Produzir relatórios parciais por Instituição Beneficiária e fornecer, trimestralmente, às Instituições Beneficiárias, a posição da execução financeira dos respectivos planos anuais de actividades e orçamento; Preparar, mensalmente, os Mapas de Compromissos e monitorar a execução financeira dos contratos, em conformidade com os termos e condições acordados entre as Partes; Garantir a recolha de todos os documentos comprovativos das transacções declaradas; Assegurar o pagamento das obrigações fiscais devidas no âmbito da implementação do Projecto;       Organizar toda documentação para as auditorias internas e externas e providenciar a assistência necessária aos auditores internos/externos durante as auditorias, assegurar a emissão de relatórios nos prazos estabelecidos e responder às constatações levantadas, incluindo o plano de acção e sua implementação. Organizar os arquivos físicos e digitais; Executar quaisquer outras tarefas atribuídas Gestor/a Financeiro e pelo/a Coordenador/a do Projecto. Os termos de referência (TOR) detalhados para a Consultoria podem ser encontrados no endereço abaixo ou podem ser fornecidos mediante solicitação para o seguinte e-mail: procurement.pled@gmail.com.   3. O Ministério das Finanças (MF) convida os consultores individuais elegíveis para submeter sua manifestação de interesse para a posição de Especialista de Contabilidade para o Projecto. Os consultores interessados devem fornecer informações que demonstrem que possuem as qualificações exigidas e a experiência relevante para prestar os serviços (CV, experiência de trabalho em condições similares, disponibilidade, etc).   O Especialista de Contabilidade deve ter no mínimo as seguintes qualificações e experiência: Formação superior nas áreas de Gestão Financeira, Contabilidade e Auditoria, Economia, Gestão de Empresas ou outras áreas afins; Pelo menos cinco (5) anos de experiência na gestão financeira de Projectos financiados pelo Banco Mundial e/ou outras organizações internacionais de desenvolvimento; Ter experiência no uso de sistema de administração financeira do Estado (SISTAFE) incluindo a plataforma informática e-Sistafe; Capacidade de trabalho em equipa e de articulação com entidades públicas e privadas; Habilidades de comunicação e capacidade para apresentar, negociar, e resolver questões complexas; Domínio de técnicas e normas nacionais e internacionais de relato financeiro nos sectores público e privado; Experiência nas áreas de formação e auditoria é uma vantagem; Domínio da língua portuguesa e conhecimentos de língua inglesa; Domínio das aplicações de office (processamento de texto e planilhas de processamento de dados). Domínio de utilização de pacotes informáticos de Contabilidade, incluindo o PRIMAVERA; Capacidade de trabalhar sob pressão e de forma independente; Capacidade de organização, ética e proatividade. 4. A duração do contrato de 12 meses, com possibilidade de renovação (em períodos sucessivos) conforme a avaliação do desempenho anual.   5. O consultor será selecionado de acordo com o método de selecção de consultor individual estabelecido no Regulamento de Aquisições do Banco Mundial.   6. Mais informações podem ser obtidas no endereço abaixo entre as 08.30 as 15.30 horas durante os dias normais de expediente.   7. As manifestações de interesse deverão ser submetidas por escrito no endereço abaixo (pessoalmente ou por e-mail) , até 14.30 horas, do dia 27 de Novembro de 2026 .   Ministério das Finanças Direcção Nacional do Tesouro e Cooperação Financeira Projecto de Acesso ao Financiamento e Oportunidades Económicas: Mais Oportunidades Unidade de Coordenação do Projecto Av. do Zimbabwe, No. 1374 Maputo – Moçambique Telefone: +258 21081643 Email: procurement.pled@gmail.com

postings.text: Secretary | EC - European Commission Skip to main content Secretary EC - European Commission Brussels Both national and international FG II, Function Group 2, Contract Agent level Speaks English Application deadline: November 27, 2026 (11 days) Apply Summary by Impactpool The European Commission is seeking a Secretary for the DG Communications Networks, Content and Technology in Brussels. This role involves providing administrative support to the Head of Unit and the team, ensuring adherence to administrative rules and procedures. The position requires strong organizational skills, the ability to multitask, and effective communication in an English-speaking environment. Candidates should be proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of managing logistics for meetings and events. Candidate Requirements: Dynamic and proactive Well-organized Good secretarial and administrative skills Strong sense of initiative and responsibility Ability to multitask under time pressure Strong team player Excellent organizational skills Good communication and interpersonal skills Ability to work in English; other EU languages are a plus Knowledge of administrative procedures and IT tools (ARES, BASIS, etc.) Proficient in Word, Excel, and PowerPoint VACANCY NOTICE - CONTRACT AGENT Job title Secretary Reference EC/2026/CNECT/459386 Application deadline 27/11/2026 - 12.00 (noon, Brussels time) Directorate-General (full name) DG Communications Networks, Content and Technology (DG CONNECT) Unit CNECT.H.2 -Cybersecurity and Digital Privacy Policy Place of assignment Brussels Domain European Policy Contract type and Function Group Contract Agent 3b FG II Other useful information Initial contract duration: 1 year About us DG CONNECT supports the digital transformation of our economy and society and conceives and implements the policies required to foster the internal market, to make Europe fit for the Digital age and to gain technological autonomy. We are a unit of 19 friendly and committed colleagues in charge of policy and law in the areas of cybersecurity. We are responsible for a number of high-profile files in the field of cybersecurity such as the NIS2 Directive, the Cyber Resilience Act, the European Cybersecurity Certification Framework (Cybersecurity Act), the Action Plan on Cybersecurity and AI. Within the Commission, we are also responsible for international cyber relations and the EU Cyber Defence policy and EU NATO cooperation in the field of cybersecurity. The unit collaborates closely with the Cybersecurity Technology & Capacity Building Unit (CONNECT.H.1) and the Cyber Coordination Unit (CONNECT.H3). The Directorate applies a team-oriented approach, encouraging a no-silo collaboration benefiting from DG CONNECT's expertise in ICT and the digital single market and bringing together teams across various services. About the role We propose a position of administrative assistant in the secretariat of the unit, supporting the Head of Unit and the Unit. We offer a varied, dynamic and interesting job in a friendly environment which will cover a wide range of administrative tasks and secretarial duties that have the overall purpose to assist the Head of Unit and the Unit in the implementation of administrative and staff rules and procedures, in order to deliver the expected outputs and ensure the smooth administration of the Unit.. Such specific tasks would, among others, consist of: administrative support for the Head of Unit and the Unit to follow rules and procedure using the appropriate Commission's administrative tools (e.g. ARES, BASIS, DECIDE); oversee the implementation of administrative rules and procedures to be applied in the programmes / actions for the Unit and contribute to their simplification; organization of and support for external meetings and logistics, as well as meetings and missions for the Head of Unit and Unit's colleagues; support and logistics for organisation and holding of meetings of expert groups and events relating to the Unit's files; support, in collaboration with the finance and contracts assistant in the DG in the supervision of the respect of financial, budgetary and contractual rules, procedures and deadlines; support to the Head of Unit on administrative handling of Human Resources aspects; coordinate tasks relating to issues involving several sectors, teams or colleagues within the Unit; ensure incoming inter-services consultation requests are properly distributed in the Unit and that replies are introduced in due time; oversee and allocate the preparation of briefings, presentations and speeches; open/register/filter incoming email and route email to appropriate colleagues, follow-up of deadlines; manage and keep the Head of Unit's agenda updated, ensure that the setup actions are attributed and followed up properly, and that the deadlines are respected; carry out various other administrative tasks such as diary-keeping, filtering calls, filing and drafting of standard notes and documents; perform administrative quality checks on files for signature. Qualifications, experience and skills We look for a dynamic, proactive and well-organised person with good secretarial and administrative skills and a strong sense of initiative and responsibility. This position would specifically require strong motivation and the ability to multitask and work under time pressure. S/he should be a strong team player and be able to organise her/his work autonomously; Good planning, diligence and attention to detail, the ability to perform multiple tasks within set deadlines and adjust to changing priorities are essential. S/he should have excellent organisational skills and proven ability to effectively arrange logistics and support events and large meetings; A positive attitude, good communication and interpersonal skills, as well as excellent human relations and strong sense of teamwork, are very important; S/he should be able to effectively work in an English-speaking environment. Knowledge of other EU languages would be an advantage; A good knowledge of the administrative procedures of the Commission, including IT-based tools (ARES, BASIS, Decide, MIPS, Sysper, etc.), is an advantage; Ability to work with Word, Excel and PowerPoint is necessary. How to express your interest? You should send your documents in one single pdf in the following order: Your CV Completed application form Please send these documents by the publication deadline to CNECT-H2@ec.europa.eu and Raluca.STEFANUC@ec.europa.eu and indicating the selection reference EC/2026/CNECT/459386 Eligibility, recruitment steps, contract and working conditions Please consult the pdf document at the end of this page At Impactpool we do our best to provide you the most accurate info, but closing dates may be wrong on our site. Please check on the recruiting organization's page for the exact info. Candidates are responsible for complying with deadlines and are encouraged to submit applications well ahead. Before applying, please make sure that you have read the requirements for the position and that you qualify. Applications from non-qualifying applicants will most likely be discarded by the recruiting manager. postings.text: AVIS DE SOLLICITATION A MANIFESTATION D’INTERET SELECTION DES CONSULTANTS PAR LES EMPRUNTEURS DE LA BANQUE MONDIALE NOM DU PAYS                               : REPUBLIQUE CENTRAFRICAINE NOM DU PROJET                            : PROJET DES FILETS SOCIAUX ADAPTATIFS ET                                                                    PRODUCTIFS « NDOYE » N° IDENTIFICATION DU PROJET  : P 179211 N° DU DON                                          : IDA n°E3290 et n°E4660-CF INTITULE DE LA MISSION  :   Recrutement d’un Consultant Webmaster pour la conception et la mise en ligne du site web du Projet de Filets Sociaux Adaptatifs et Productifs « NDOYE » 1.  Le Gouvernement de la République Centrafricaine a obtenu un financement auprès de l’Association Internationale pour le Développement (AID) du groupe de la Banque mondiale afin de financer le Projet des Filets Sociaux Adaptatifs et Productifs « NDOYE » et a l’intention d’utiliser une partie des ressources pour financer les Services de Consultants individuels cités ci-dessus. 2.  Le Ministère de l’Action Humanitaire, de la Solidarité et de la Réconciliation Nationale (MAHSRN), autorité de tutelle du Projet des Filets Sociaux Adaptatifs et Productifs “NDOYE“, a confié à l’Unité d’Appui à la Mise en Œuvre du Projet (UAMOP) le recrutement des Consultants du Projet. 3. À ce titre, la Coordination de l’UAMOP recrute un Consultant Webmaster pour la conception et la mise en ligne du site web du Projet NDOYE. 4. Les consultants intéressés par cette mission doivent fournir les informations démontrant qu’ils possèdent les qualifications requises et les expériences pertinentes pour l’exécution des services demandés. Le dossier de candidature comprendra les pièces suivantes: Une lettre de motivation; Un curriculum Vitae détaillé, certifié incluant les références de deux (2) personnes pouvant attester les compétences techniques et les qualités interpersonnelles du candidat ; Les copies des attestations de services faits mettant en valeur ses expériences et ses compétences en lien avec la consultation  . 5. Les étapes du recrutement sont les suivantes: (i) analyse des dossiers de candidature et (ii) négociation du contrat avec le candidat le plus expérimenté et le plus qualifié pour la mission. La Coordination de l’UAMOP se réserve le droit de vérifier l’ensemble des informations fournies par les candidats lors la procédure de sélection. 6. Un Consultant sera sélectionné par poste selon les dispositions 7.36 et 7.37 de la méthode de sélection des consultants individuels définies dans le « Règlement de Passation des Marchés dans le cadre du financement des projets de développement « Fournitures, Travaux, Services autres que des Services de Consultants », 7e édition de septembre 2025. 7. Les Candidats intéressés peuvent obtenir les Termes de référence de ces différentes missions à l’adresse ci-dessous et aux heures tous les jours ouvrables de 9 heures à 15 heures auprès de l’Unité d’Appui à la Mise en Œuvre du Projet NDOYE à compter de la publication du présent avis. 8. Les manifestations d’intérêt écrites doivent être déposées par porteur sous pli cacheté en deux (2) exemplaires ou envoyer par courrier express au plus tard le mercredi 25 novembre 2026 à 12 heures 00 minutes, heure locale, à l’adresse suivante:  Attention de : Madame Lydie Flore OUASSERE KONGBO-KETTE Coordonnatrice de l’Unité d’Appui à la Mise en Œuvre du Projet NDOYE Avenue de France, enceinte de la Direction Générale de la Promotion du Genre BP 917 Bangui, République Centrafricaine Tél : +236 75 05 52 35 / +236 75 50 02 87 Email : kongbolydie@gmail.com, copie à dekoupou@yahoo.fr Elles doivent être transmises avec la mention :  « Manifestation d’intérêt – Recrutement d’un Consultant Webmaster pour la conception et la mise en ligne du site web du Projet de Filets Sociaux Adaptatifs et Productifs « NDOYE   L’ouverture des manifestations est prévue le mercredi 25 novembre 2026 à 13 heures, heure locale, dans la salle de réunion de la Coordination du Projet NDOYE. Fait à Bangui, le 13 novembre 2026 La Coordonnatrice de l’UAMOP NDOYE    L ydie Flore OUASSERE KONGBO-KETTE

postings.text: APPEL A MANIFESTATIONS D’INTÉRÊT (CONSULTANTS INDIVIDUELS) Pays                                 :      Madagascar Projet                              :      Préparation du Projet de Transport Multimodal et de Logistique (PTML) Maître d’Ouvrage         :      Ministère des Transports et de la Météorologie (MTM) Numéro                           :      Crédit IDA-E5850 Intitulé de la Mission     :     Recrutement du Responsable en Passation de Marchés auprès du projet PTML N° de référence              :      021-PTML-CS-INDV Emis le                               :      11 novembre 2026 1.  Le Gouvernement de la République de Madagascar (ci-après dénommé l’« Emprunteur ») a obtenu un financement de l’Association Internationale de Développement (IDA) (la « Banque ») sous la forme d’un « Don » (ci-après dénommé « fonds ») en vue de financer les coûts de la phase préparatoire du Projet de Transport Multimodal et de Logistique (PTML). Le Projet a l’intention d’utiliser une partie de ce don pour recruter un Responsable en passation de marchés du Projet PTML.  2. Le Responsable de la passation des marchés est chargé de conduire et de coordonner les activités de passation de marchés du projet relevant de l’UCP (Composantes 2, 3 et 4), conformément aux règles et procédures établies. Les Termes de Référence (TDR) détaillés peuvent être obtenus à l’adresse ci-dessous. 3. L’Unité de Coordination de la Préparation du Projet PTML invite les candidats intéressés en tant que Consultants individuels à postuler pour le poste du Responsable en Passation de Marchés. Les principaux critères de sélection sont : Titulaire d’un Diplôme minimum Bacc + 4 en gestion, droit, supply chain management ou dans d’autres domaines apparentés, Au moins 7 ans d’expériences satisfaisantes dans le domaine de la Passation de Marchés dans un poste similaire, dans les 10 dernières années, Au moins 4 ans d’expériences avérées dans un projet financé par les Bailleurs de fonds internationaux dans les 10 dernières années, Connaissance des procédures de passation de marchés de la Banque Mondiale spécialement les procédures définies dans le Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs sollicitant le Financement de projets d’Investissement (FPI), Parlant le Malgache et le français avec capacité de rédaction, Apte à effectuer des déplacements dans des localités éloignées et dans des conditions difficiles, notamment sur les sites du Projet (Mahajanga, Toliara, Toamasina, Taolagnaro, Canal des Pangalanes, etc.). Atouts : Une bonne connaissance du Suivi Systématique des Échanges dans la Passation des Marchés (STEP) constituerait un avantage Connaissance de l’Anglais Formation en Passation de marchés Expérience réussie dans un projet financé par la Banque mondiale 4. L’attention des Consultants est attirée sur la Section III, paragraphes 3.15, 3.16 et 3.17 du « Règlement de Passation des Marchés pour les Emprunteurs de Projets d’Investissement financés par la Banque mondiale », édition de septembre 2025, qui précise la politique de la Banque mondiale en matière de conflits d’intérêts. Veuillez également vous référer aux informations spécifiques relatives aux conflits d’intérêts conformément au paragraphe 3.13 des Règlements. 5. Les dossiers de candidature devront comporter une lettre de motivation rédigée en français, un CV avec photo récente, des copies des diplômes, un numéro de téléphone, son adresse mail pour contact rapide 6. Les Consultants intéressés sont invités à retirer les termes de référence du poste à l’adresse indiquée ci-dessous. Le TDR est également disponible en version électronique en envoyant une demande à l’adresse ci-dessous. Le nom et l’adresse du Consultant devront être spécifiés dans la demande. 7. Les manifestations d’intérêt doivent être transmises en personne, par courrier, ou email à l’adresse ciaprès au plus tard le : mercredi 25 novembre 2026 à 10 heures. À l’attention de           :           Madame Le Coordonnateur de Projet                                                 Unité de Coordination de la Préparation du Projet - Projet de Transport Multimodal et de Logistique (PTML) Adresse du bureau      :           Rez-de-chaussée de la Maison des Projets, enceinte de l’Agence Routière à Alarobia, Antananarivo 101, Madagascar Adresse électronique  :           vero.rakotomalala@ptml.mg                                                 Copies : rija.andrianaivoson@ptml.mg, mirana.rasoa@ptml.mg et vahatra.rajoelina@ptml.mg    Référence : «021-PTML-CS-INDV, Recrutement du « Responsable en Passation de Marchés »

postings.text: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (MOES-IC-02-FMS-4 – Financial management specialist) Market Approach - Open, National UKRAINE Ukraine Improving Higher Education for Results Project  Lifting Education Access and Resilience in Times of Need in Ukraine Program Loan Agreement No. 9238-UA; Grant No. TF0C5794   Assignment Title: Financial management specialist Reference No. MOES-IC-02-FMS-4 The Ministry of Education and Science of Ukraine is implementing projects financed by the World Bank, including Ukraine Improving Higher Education for Results Project (UIHERP) and Lifting Education Access and Resilience in times of Need in Ukraine Program (LEARN) Program (hereinafter referred to as the Operations) and intends to apply part of the proceeds for consulting services.  The UIHERP aims to increase efficiency and improve conditions to ensure quality and transparency in the higher education system of Ukraine. LEARN was developed to address critical challenges and provide essential support to the education sector, aligning with the Ministry of Education and Science’s (MoES) Strategic Action Plan. The objectives of the Operation are to (i) improve teaching and learning conditions; and (ii) strengthen management capacity of the education system. The objective of this assignment is to provide assistance and advice to MoES on financial management under the Project in accordance with IBRD and national legislation requirements.  The Consultant will be contracted through competitive selection in line with the World Bank’s “Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers” September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”).  The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs, 3.14, 3.16, and 3.17 of the Procurement Regulations, setting forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. MOES now invites qualified interested persons to submit their expression of interest in Ukrainian and English as provided in the Terms of reference available at the link https://docs.google.com/document/d/1V5a8f5hjXPg4RpikFEZhLPnzra8vom5I/edit?usp=sharing&ouid=102804749623383420564&rtpof=true&sd=true  The detailed Terms of Reference and submission modalities for the assignment are attached to this Request for Expression of Interest. The deadline for submission of applications is 11:00 am Kyiv time on November 25, 2026.

postings.text: SOLICITUD DE EXPRESIÓN DE INTERÉS CONTRATACIÓN DE CONSULTOR INDIVIDUAL   NOMBRE DE LA CONSULTORÍA: ESPECIALISTA SOCIAL UNIDAD DE PRESTACIÓN DE LOS SERVICIOS: UNIDAD TÉCNICA AEROPORTUARIA — MOPSV REFERENCIA STEP: BO-UTA-580791-CS-IND                                                        El Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia ha recibido financiamiento del Banco Mundial (BM) para cubrir el costo de la Preparación de proyectos (P516619) en relación con el Programa para el Fortalecimiento de la Sostenibilidad Institucional y Financiera del Sector Transporte, a través de la Carta Acuerdo de Cooperación Técnica No Reembolsable Grant No. TF D1775 , y tiene la intención de aplicar parte de los fondos a la contratación de servicios de consultoría.   El Ministerio de Obras Públicas, Servicios y Vivienda (MOPSV), a través de la Unidad Técnica Aeroportuaria (UTA), invita a consultores elegibles a indicar su interés en proporcionar los Servicios. Se llama la atención de los Consultores interesados sobre la Sección III, Regulaciones de Adquisiciones, contempladas en los Párrafos 3.13, 3.15, 3.16, 3.17, 3.20  y 3.21, que establece la política del Banco Mundial sobre "Conflicto de Interés" y "Elegibilidad" para Servicios de Consultoría.   FORMA Y PLAZO DE PRESENTACIÓN DE POSTULACIONES:  Las personas interesadas que cumplan con los requisitos mínimos deberán presentar su expresión de interés en sobre cerrado o correo electrónico [contrataciones.plm@oopp.gob.bo], a más tardar hasta horas 15:00 del día 23 de noviembre de 2026. El proceso de evaluación se iniciará a horas 15:15, en oficinas de la Unidad Técnica Aeroportuaria (UTA) del MOPSV, en la dirección indicada al final de este anuncio.   Las expresiones de interés deberán incluir la Hoja de Vida (Anexo III) documentada en fotocopia simple, en los formatos que se encuentran en la presente convocatoria. postings.text: SOLICITUD DE EXPRESIÓN DE INTERÉS CONTRATACIÓN DE CONSULTOR INDIVIDUAL   NOMBRE DE LA CONSULTORÍA: ESPECIALISTA EN GESTIÓN FINANCIERA UNIDAD DE PRESTACIÓN DE LOS SERVICIOS: UNIDAD TÉCNICA AEROPORTUARIA (UTA) — MOPSV REFERENCIA STEP: BO-UTA-580787-CS-IND     El Estado Plurinacional de Bolivia ha recibido financiamiento del Banco Mundial (BM) para cubrir el costo de la Preparación de proyectos (P516619) en relación con el Programa para el Fortalecimiento de la Sostenibilidad Institucional y Financiera del Sector Transporte, a través de la Carta Acuerdo de Cooperación Técnica No Reembolsable Grant No. TF D1775 , y tiene la intención de aplicar parte de los fondos a la contratación de servicios de consultoría.   El Ministerio de Obras Públicas, Servicios y Vivienda (MOPSV), a través de la Unidad Técnica Aeroportuaria (UTA), invita a consultores elegibles a indicar su interés en proporcionar los Servicios. Los Consultores interesados deben proporcionar información que demuestre que tienen las calificaciones requeridas y la experiencia relevante para prestar los Servicios.   Los Términos de Referencia y los Documentos de Selección para la presentación de postulaciones podrán ser recabados en la página web del SICOES https://www.sicoes.gob.bo/portal/index.php o solicitarse a la siguiente dirección vía correo electrónico: contrataciones.uta@oopp.gob.bo , o en las oficinas de la Unidad Técnica Aeroportuaria del MOPSV, en la dirección indicada al final de este anuncio, a partir del día 13 de noviembre de 2026.   Los consultores serán seleccionados mediante el método de Selección Abierta y Competitiva de Consultores Individuales descrito en las Regulaciones de Adquisiciones para Prestatarios en Proyectos de Inversión (Séptima Edición, septiembre de 2025). Se llama la atención de los Consultores interesados sobre la Sección III, Regulaciones de Adquisiciones, contempladas en los Párrafos 3.13, 3.15, 3.16, 3.17, 3.20 y 3.21, que establece la política del Banco Mundial sobre "Conflicto de Interés" y "Elegibilidad" para Servicios de Consultoría.   FORMA Y PLAZO DE PRESENTACIÓN DE POSTULACIONES:  Las personas interesadas que cumplan con los requisitos mínimos deberán presentar su expresión de interés en sobre cerrado o correo electrónico contrataciones.uta@oopp.gob.bo, a más tardar hasta horas 11:00 del día 20 de noviembre de 2026. El proceso de evaluación se iniciará a horas 11:15, en oficinas de la Unidad Técnica Aeroportuaria (UTA) MOPSV, en la dirección indicada al final de este anuncio.   Las expresiones de interés deberán incluir la Hoja de Vida (Anexo III) documentada en fotocopia simple, en los formatos que se encuentran en la presente convocatoria. Los documentos recibidos no serán devueltos independientemente del resultado del proceso de selección. El candidato seleccionado deberá presentar los respectivos documentos de respaldo originales para verificación y cotejo antes de la firma del contrato. Entidad: Unidad Técnica Aeroportuaria (UTA) — MOPSV Dirección: Av. Mariscal Santa Cruz, Edificio Centro de Comunicaciones (Piso 10).

postings.title: Social Specialist for Bystrovskaya Small HPP and 110 kV Lower Tar – Kara-Kuldzha Transmission Line
postings.posting_type: Request for Expression of Interest / Individual Consultant Selection
postings.text: REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST Kyrgyz Republic Project: Kyrgyz Renewable Energy Development Project (KRED) Assignment Title: Social Specialist (Individual Consultant) Package #KG/KRED/CS/2026/IC-04 REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (INDIVIDUAL CONSULTANT) The Ministry of Energy of the Kyrgyz Republic, under the World Bank-financed Kyrgyz Renewable Energy Development Project (KRED), invites qualified individual consultants to express their interest in providing consulting services for monitoring compliance with social requirements during the rehabilitation of the Bystrovskaya Small Hydropower Plant (SHPP) and the construction of the 110 kV "Nizhniy Tar – Kara-Kuldzha" overhead transmission line. Minimum Qualification Requirements Interested individual consultants should demonstrate that they possess the required qualifications and relevant professional experience to perform the assignment, including: Education: A university degree in Social Sciences (Sociology, Anthropology, Land Management, Regional and Urban Development and Planning, or related fields) or Economics (Economics, Finance, or related disciplines). Professional Experience: At least five (5) years of professional experience in social development, social safeguards compliance, resettlement planning, and/or stakeholder consultations within internationally donor-funded projects in the Kyrgyz Republic. Resettlement and Land Acquisition: Experience in preparing and/or implementing Resettlement Action Plans (RAPs) and Abbreviated Resettlement Action Plans (ARAPs), as well as land acquisition activities, particularly for linear infrastructure projects (overhead transmission lines, electricity networks, or roads), will be a significant advantage. International Social Standards: Knowledge of the World Bank Environmental and Social Framework (ESF) and Environmental and Social Standards (ESS), particularly ESS2, ESS4, ESS5, and ESS10, together with practical experience in their application. Experience in community engagement and social monitoring and supervision under projects financed by the World Bank or other International Financial Institutions (IFIs) will be an advantage. National Legislation: Knowledge of the legislation of the Kyrgyz Republic concerning land relations, land acquisition and allocation, establishment of protection zones for electricity network facilities, and labor legislation. Sector-Specific Experience: Knowledge of the socio-economic context of the Kyrgyz Republic relevant to energy sector projects and experience in similar assignments will be an advantage. Communication and Stakeholder Engagement: Strong communication, interpersonal, and organizational skills, including the ability to organize and conduct stakeholder consultations and public discussions, as well as to manage and respond to grievances, complaints, and suggestions from affected communities. Language Skills: Fluency in Russian is mandatory. Knowledge of Kyrgyz for communication with local communities will be a significant advantage. Knowledge of English will also be an advantage. Computer Skills: Proficiency in MS Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint). Fieldwork Availability: Willingness to work predominantly in field conditions (up to 70% of working time), including regular site visits to both Project locations in Kemin, Chuy Region, and Kara-Kuldzha District, Osh Region, as well as extended field missions. Terms of Reference The detailed scope of consulting services, responsibilities, qualification requirements, and conditions of the assignment are provided in the Terms of Reference (ToR), available in English and Russian. Interested consultants are encouraged to review the Terms of Reference before submitting their Expressions of Interest. Submission of Expressions of Interest Qualified individual consultants are invited to submit their Expressions of Interest demonstrating their relevant qualifications and professional experience in accordance with the Terms of Reference. Expressions of Interest must be submitted in English, electronically , to the following email address: Email: kred.pmo@gmail.com Deadline: November 18, 2026, at 16:00 (Bishkek local time, GMT+6).

postings.text: Vanuatu Affordable and Resilient Settlements Project (VARS) REQUEST FOR EXPRESSIONS OF INTEREST (REOI) - Readvertised Consulting Services – Firm Assignment Title: Real Estate Agent/ Firm Duty Station : PMU, Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources, Port Vila, Vanuatu Date of Publication: 09 October 2026 Deadline for submission: 31 October 2026 at time: 1400 Hours. Submission deadline extended: 17th November 2026 at 2:00 PM Reference Number: VU-MLNR-568293-CS-LCS 1. BACKGROUND OF THE PROJECT: The Government, through the World Bank-funded Vanuatu Affordable and Resilient Settlements (VARS) Project, is undertaking the development and sale of the Elol Etas (Etas Gardens) Subdivision, being a pilot subdivision to address the growing demand for affordable, resilient, and well-planned urban expansion in the Greater Port Vila area. The Etas Subdivision is designed as a pilot model for government-led urban development. It is an opportunity to work with the private sector to plan, build, and deliver affordable serviced lots in a manner that is: Economically viable Environmentally resilient , and Socially inclusive The subdivision comprises 136 lots in total , consisting of 130 residential lots and six (6) non-residential lots (the Market, Hilltop Park, neighbourhood parks, and escarpment and drainage reserves). Of the 130 residential lots, six (6) have already been allocated to the three customary landowner families (two lots each) . This leaves 124 residential lots available for sale through the ESMASP allocation process , supported by a reserve list of 260 applicants. The six non-residential lots are expected to remain with Government, with the responsible agencies still to be confirmed. The subdivision is planned with culturally sensitive and pedestrian-focused urban design principles, including road and pedestrian access, drainage, green spaces, access to public services, and typical lot sizes of 400 m² (refer to attached Subdivision Plan). It specifically targets low- and lower-middle-income households , enabling access to land and secure tenure for Vanuatu citizens who are otherwise excluded from the formal housing market due to rising land costs and informal settlement conditions. In addition, the project: Promotes equity and fairness by using transparent eligibility criteria and selection processes. Supports national housing policy goals under the National Land Subdivision Policy. Establishes a replicable model for future subdivisions by private developers. Addresses urbanization challenges by providing planned residential opportunities that reduce pressure on unregulated and informal urban growth. Ultimately, the Elol Etas Subdivision represents a strategic intervention by government to promote resilient, inclusive, and sustainable urban development that supports Vanuatu’s long-term socio-economic and environmental goals. The subdivision will be distinctive due to lot size (typically 400 m²) and the use of laneways that promote pedestrian (and not vehicle) modes of transport. The tenure type will be a Standard ‘derivative’ lease. The sale price will be set as Vt 1.71 million, irrespective of the size or location of the lot within the subdivision. A list of successful applicants, pre-allocated to subdivision lots through the Elol Etas Subdivision Marketing, Allocation and Sale Process (ESMASP), will be provided to the Real Estate Agent to facilitate the sales and settlement process. This includes collection of purchaser deposits, preparation of purchaser documentation (Sale and Purchase Agreement), and coordination with the vendor’s Conveyancing Lawyer to ensure completion of settlement and lease transfer registration. 1.1 Nature of the Assignment This assignment differs in important respects from a conventional subdivision sale. Many of the higher-risk and more resource-intensive activities normally undertaken by a real estate agency have already been completed by the project , including the marketing campaign, applicant registration, eligibility assessment, the lot allocation process, preparation of the reserve list, community engagement, and much of the purchaser administration. The Real Estate Agent is therefore engaged to perform a primarily administrative sales coordination and settlement role , rather than a traditional full-service marketing and sales function. The remaining activities are largely administrative and repetitive in nature, and much of the commercial risk normally associated with residential subdivision sales has been removed by the project. Firms should have careful regard to the services included in, and excluded from, this assignment (Sections 3.1–3.4) when preparing their proposals and pricing. The ESMASP Manager will coordinate the implementation of the subdivision sales process and will act as the primary operational interface between MoLNR, the Real Estate Agent, and the Conveyancing Lawyer. 2. PURPOSE OF THE ASSIGNMENT: The primary objective of this engagement is to support the sales and settlement coordination process for the 124 residential lots available through the ESMASP allocation process. The Real Estate Agent will: Support allocated purchasers during the sales process. Prepare and manage purchaser documentation associated with the sale process. Collect and hold deposits in a dedicated trust account meeting the safeguard requirements set out in Section 9 and Annex A. Coordinate with the vendor’s Conveyancing Lawyer to facilitate settlement and registration of lease transfers. 3. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE: The selected Real Estate Agent/Firm must meet the following minimum qualifications and experience: 3.1 Firm Qualifications and Experience A real estate agent or agency registered and licensed to operate in Vanuatu, with a minimum of five (5) years of demonstrated experience in property sales, preferably including subdivision or multi-lot sales. This experience may be demonstrated through the track record of the proposed key personnel, whether gained as an independent practitioner or within a larger agency. Proven track record in coordinating property sales transactions, purchaser documentation and settlement processes. Experience working with government agencies and community stakeholders. Strong knowledge of local real estate market conditions and target buyer demographics. Experience in trust account management and real estate regulatory compliance. 3.2 Key Experts / Personnel Key experts/personnel proposed to undertake the assignment, must meet the following minimum qualifications and experience. In the case of a sole practitioner, the principal may fulfil the role of the key expert, consistent with Section 6.3. Lead Sales Coordinator (Principal Agent): a licensed real estate agent with a minimum of five (5) years of experience in property sales, purchaser documentation and settlement coordination, and the ability to communicate clearly and respectfully with purchasers in Bislama and English. Trust Account / Administration Support: demonstrated experience in trust account operation, financial record-keeping and monthly reconciliations. This function may be performed by the Lead Sales Coordinator in a sole-practitioner submission. 4. REPORTING: The Real Estate Agent will report to the Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources (MoLNR) and coordinate operationally with the ESMASP Manager and the VARS Project Management Unit (PMU). Regular check-ins and status meetings will be conducted to ensure alignment with project goals. For contract-management purposes, the supervising officer is the ESMASP Manager, VARS PMU, acting on behalf of MoLNR. 5. DURATION OF ASSIGNMENT : Indicatively up to 14 months from contract commencement; final duration as per contract terms. 6. SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS: The attention of interested Consultants is drawn to Section III, paragraphs 3.15, 3.16 and 3.17 of the World Bank’s Procurement Regulations for IPF Borrowers: Procurement in Investment Project Financing – Goods, Works, Non-Consulting and Consulting Services, Seventh Edition, September 2025 (“Procurement Regulations”), which set forth the World Bank’s policy on conflict of interest. A Consultant will be selected in accordance with the Least Cost Selection (LCS) Method set out in the World Bank Procurement Regulations . Interested applicants may obtain further information including a detailed Terms of Reference from the Ministry in person or by e-mail to the address given below during office hours from 8.00 a.m.– 5.00 p.m. Monday to Friday. Interested firms are requested to submit an Expression of Interest (EOI) demonstrating their qualifications and experience to undertake the assignment. The EOI should include, at a minimum: Company/agency profile. Evidence of current registration and licensing to operate as a real estate agent/agency in Vanuatu. Details of relevant experience in similar assignments and/or property sales transactions. Evidence of experience in trust account management and associated financial record-keeping. CV of the proposed Lead Sales Coordinator/Principal Agent, demonstrating the required qualifications and experience; and Contact details for at least two (2) professional references who may be contacted to verify the firm’s relevant experience and performance. Interested firms should provide sufficient information to demonstrate that they meet the minimum qualifications and experience requirements specified in this REOI. Address: Vanuatu Affordable and Resilient Settlements Project (VARS). Ministry of Lands and Natural Resources (MoLNR) Socapo Area, Port Vila Email to: spo@vars.vu cc’d to pm@vars.vu / cm@vars.vu Click here to download Terms of Reference (ToR)

postings.text: Anúncio de concurso público para o recrutamento de um Especialista em Governança Digital O governo da Guiné-Bissau recebeu financiamento do Banco Mundial no âmbito do Projeto Regional de Integração Digital na África Ocidental e pretende utilizar uma parte do montante desta doação para efetuar pagamentos ao abrigo de um contrato de reforço da capacidade de Implementação do projeto, com o recrutamento de um Especialista em Serviços Financeiros Digital. O Projeto Regional de Integração Digital na África Ocidental (WARDIP GB) integra quatro componentes, a saber: Componente 1: Desenvolvimento e integração do mercado de conectividade Componente 2: Desenvolvimento e integração do mercado de dados Componente 3: Desenvolvimento e integração de mercado on-line Componente 4: Gestão de Projetos e Apoio à Implementação PERFIL E QUALIFICAÇÃO Qualificações académicas e profissionais Mestrado ou licenciatura mais 10 anos de experiência profissional em contabilidade, negócios, finanças, economia ou outra área relacionada. Pelo menos 10 anos de experiência relevante ou certificação de disciplina relacionada na área desta tarefa (serviços financeiros digitais e pagamentos digitais, etc. NB: As Qualificações académicas e profissionais completas são incluídas nos Termos de Referência do Consultor. Requisitos de Conhecimento, Competências e Habilidades Conhecimento prático e teorético dos desenvolvimentos atuais de serviços financeiros digitais, incluindo dinheiro móvel, carteiras e pagamentos móveis. Habilidades analíticas de interpretar dados e evoluções no mercado, bem como conhecimento e experiência demonstrados de pagamentos digitais e serviços financeiros. Conhecimento de questões políticas e legais/regulatórias do país e na região relacionadas com pagamentos eletrônicos e serviços financeiros digitais; NB: 2. Os Requisitos de Conhecimento, Competências e Habilidades completos são incluídos nos Termos de Referência do Consultor. LOCAL DE TRABALHO O Especialista em Serviços Financeiros Digital ficará sediado na Unidade de Coordenação do Projeto em Bissau e responderá ao Coordenador do Projeto. MÉTODO DE SELECÇÃO O Especialista em Serviços Financeiros Digital será recrutado segundo o método de Seleção de Consultor Individual / Individual Consultant Selection, em conformidade com as regras e os procedimentos definidos no regulamento de aquisições do Banco Mundial para os mutuários. DURAÇÃO DA PRESTAÇÃO O Consultor deverá ser contratado em regime de tempo integral, por um período de 1 (um) ano, renovável com base no bom desempenho. A remuneração será paga mensalmente. As candiadaturas deverão ser dirigidas a Sede do Projeto  WARDIP sito: Bairro de Brá-Penha, Bissau ou através do email: anibaldee@gmail.com Cc: aaronerrachid@outlook.com ; severianogomes72@gmail.com , o mais tardar até as 10h00min dia 11 de dezembro de 2026 e deverão conter os seguintes documentos: Carta de motivação assinada; Um Copia autenticada do Bilhete de Identidade ou Passaporte; Curriculum vitae; Copias autenticada dos diplomas e certificados habilitações; Cartas de recomendação (facultativo); Outros documentos se necessários. Os termos de referência poderão ser adquiridos no escritório do Projeto  WARDIP sito: Bairro de Brá-Penha, Bissau ou através do email: anibaldee@gmail.com Cc: aaronerrachid@outlook.com ; severianogomes72@gmail.com   An í bal Fernando Braima Delgado Bald é WARDIP-Guin é -Bissau Coordenador
